title: An app unit under systemd
caption: deploy/systemd/velexis-*.service: Restart=always, RestartSec=3, RestartMode=direct, StartLimitBurst=10 in StartLimitIntervalSec=300, OnFailure=velexis-alert@%n.service.

states.label: inactive / disabled
states.detail: Enabled by `velexis-deploy` once a release contains the app.

states.label: auto-restart
states.detail: A crash restarts after 3 s, silently (journal only).

states.label: failed
states.detail: 10 starts in 5 minutes: start limit hit → `velexis-alert@<unit>.service` mails status + last 40 log lines.

states.label: masked (restore drill)
states.detail: Linked to /dev/null in /etc/systemd/system.control; deploy and health check skip it.
